sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older clean-shaven man nearly frontal with a restrained serious closed mouth and slightly upward eyes, pale gray eyebrow hairs and only sparse gray side hair exposed below the cap; no moustache or beard. Broad white/light-gray naval peaked cap cropped by the upper edge, black band and visor with prominent gold anchor-in-wreath center badge, gold cord and leaf embroidery. Dark navy double-breasted-style officer coat, gold anchor lapel devices and gold shoulder decorations over a light gray shirt and black tie. Preserve the close head-and-shoulders framing, soft upper-left illumination and full muted gray-beige painted backing. Tiny cap insignia strokes are not legible enough to invent text.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man in slight three-quarter view toward screen left, looking a little upward, with round/oval thin metal-rim eyeglasses, short gray temple hair and brows, and a distinct thick bushy silver-gray moustache; chin has no beard. Large white/light-gray peaked naval cap with black band, gold cord, gold leaf-embroidered visor and prominent gold anchor-in-wreath center badge. Dark navy officer coat with small gold lapel pins and gold bars/stars on the shoulder at screen left, pale gray collared shirt and dark tie. Retain the serious closed-mouth expression, cropped bust, warm lighting from screen left and complete gray-beige backing. Fine glasses reflections and individual shoulder insignia relief are too small to resolve precisely.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older clean-shaven man with a long angular human source face, dark/gray brows and little short gray temple hair under a broad light-gray/white naval peaked cap; gaze tilted upward, serious tightly closed lips, no moustache, beard or glasses. Black cap band and visor carry a gold cord, leaf embroidery and central gold anchor/wreath badge. Dark navy coat with thin gold-edged shoulder straps and a partly cropped round gold insignia low at screen right, pale gray shirt and black tie. Preserve source pose, framing, lighting and complete muted gray-beige painted background, while adapting the face into a compact mascot head and short broad neck rather than copying the human head/neck elongation. Fine cropped badge details cannot be read reliably.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Middle-aged clean-shaven man in three-quarter view looking toward screen left and slightly upward, with short neatly combed dark-gray hair visible at temples, dark brows and a stern closed mouth, no beard, moustache or glasses. White peaked naval cap with a dark band, ornate gold center emblem, gold cord and gold-embroidered black visor. Dark navy open-lapel officer coat with narrow gold shoulder edges over a pale gray shirt and black tie. Preserve the upward-left gaze, cropped bust, asymmetric face lighting, original uniform shape and the full softly textured gray-green/beige painted rectangular backing. The cap emblem is visible as gold ornament but its tiny internal lettering is unreadable.

finalizer_source.source:
"""Finish the root b finite-group bookkeeping after actual source completion."""
import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1]
assert re.fullmatch(r'fresh-observed-20261025T[0-9]{6}-b-[0-9a-f]{8}',tag)
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v6-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_kind']=='originals' and phase['current_tag']==tag
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups']
receipt=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{tag}.json';done=read_json(receipt)
assert done['machine_id']==machine_id() and done['slot']=='b' and done['queued_originals']==4 and done['held_originals']==0
assert done['image_calls']==0 and done['quota_claims']==0
observations=ROOT/done['observations'];assert file_sha256(observations)==done['observations_sha256']
target=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-{tag}.json';assert not target.exists()
phase['completed_groups']+=1;phase.update(current_tag=None,current_kind=None,updated_at_utc=utc_now())
phase.setdefault('completed',[]).append({'tag':tag,'kind':'originals','completion':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'completed_at_utc':done['completed_at_utc']})
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot; b agent stopped','completion':done,'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'actual_source_observations':read_json(observations),'finite_phase_after_completion':phase,'finalizer_source':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},'scope':'Source observation completion already succeeded once. Only finite root b phase bookkeeping is updated here; no art approval, image call, retry or canonical portrait mutation.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
